instructionsForOffice: Remove data your office does not normally enter.
Add any data your office always enters but is missing.
Move an item between requiredData and conditionalData if necessary.
This is a workflow draft, not a legal checklist from DMV.

requiredData: Primary registrant full name or business name
Primary registrant NYS driver license or ID number, or No ID selection
Limousine or altered-seating answer: Yes or No
Damage disclosure answer: Yes or No
Vehicle modification answer: Yes or No
conditionalData: Co-registrant information and additional printed name, if there is a co-registrant
Residence address, if different from mailing address
Owner information and authorization, if owner differs from registrant
Former name and name-change answer, if the registrant changed names
Other body type description, if Body Type is Other
Other fuel description, if Fuel Type is Other
Safety-belt answer, if the vehicle is a limousine or altered vehicle
Modification description, if Vehicle Modification is Yes
Non-personal vehicle use category, if Personal Use is No
Maximum gross weight, axles, and distance, when applicable to a commercial vehicle
For-Hire, Not-For-Hire, or DOT insurance category, when applicable
DOT permit number, when DOT Operation is selected
Taxi-use category, when applicable
